keyPoints: The team is discussing conceptual design for a fruit and vegetable-themed remote control with tactile elements.
The team is debating whether to include a screen for a touch-based graphical interface or rely on physical controls like a wheel.
The team is considering material options such as rubber, plastic, wood, and titanium, with a preference for spongy, fruit-inspired textures.
The team is exploring battery options including standard batteries, solar power, and dynamos, with a focus on cost and practicality.
nextSteps: Explore tactile design ideas using stress ball material and detachable squishy components.
Evaluate cost implications for different battery options including solar and dynamos.
Develop prototypes for the fruit and vegetable-themed remote with interchangeable parts.
Determine placement of logo and battery compartment under the plastic case.
Discuss user interface options: screen vs. physical controls for navigation.
